items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Monk' multiple times as a form of address to the interviewer (e.g., 'But it was probably the best experience of my life, Monk.', 'what I found out, Monk, is most of the students...'). There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship with the jazz musician The

ctx.x: Oh yeah so I had to do that a while. But it was probably the best experience of my life, Monk. It’s interesting. I would sit — we had a thing called a jazz forum at 11:00 on a Friday afternoon. Well I’m the oldest guy in the school, I was probably older than the teachers when I went there. This was about ten years ago. So I’m sitting there and I had to pinch myself. I said I’m sitting here listening and playing music, playing jazz, and guys my age either hate their job and want to get out or try and retire. So it…
Yeah. You’ve paid some dues. If you went to a cocktail party and someone that you’d never met said, “Well Mr. Nelson, what do you do for a living?” Do you have a short answer?
